student_learning_goal: I can find different ways to pay an amount.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find different ways to pay an amount.
header.character_watermark: Tappy and Lou in the top-right with money tools. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: Three blank combo workspaces with one dollar labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 capstone three-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 blank workspaces, each labelled '$1 =' for drawing coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_DOLLAR at Part 1: keywords name the dollar combos workspace task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 3 ways to make $25 mixing bills + coins.
parts.visual_layout: Three blank combo workspaces with twenty-five dollar labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 capstone three-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 blank workspaces, each labelled '$25 =' for bills and coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_25 at Part 2: keywords name the twenty-five combos workspace task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 2 ways to make $150 (one with $100 bill, one without).
parts.visual_layout: Two blank combo workspaces with one hundred fifty labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 capstone two-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 2 blank workspaces, each labelled '$150 ='. Above: '1) WITH $100 bill. 2) WITHOUT $100 bill.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_150 at Part 3: keywords name the combos with-and-without hundred task.

parts.student_instructions: Show three different ways to make $100. Use bills only OR mixed bills + coins.
parts.visual_layout: Three boxes labelled 'Way 1, Way 2, Way 3' for the child to draw or list bills/coins. Tappy says: 'SAME AMOUNT, MANY WAYS!' on the side.
parts.answer_key: Sample: Way 1 = one $100 bill; Way 2 = two $50s; Way 3 = five $20s. Accept any three valid $100 combos.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find $200 with FEWEST pieces.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric. Part 4 added to mirror lesson Station 4 ($100 hundreds). Summative artefact now captures all 4 lesson stations.
